title: 菊花賞の後に・恐るべし福の壁

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright puts up a good fight, but she's unable to beat Matikanefukukitaru.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she's proven she can manage long-distance races as well as medium. Now we have to decide which category she should focus on.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We decide Mejiro Bright should compete in the Stayers Stakes as another test of her potential as a stayer.
